title: HerHealthGPT: An Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI System for Women's Reproductive Health Copy title
abstract: arXiv:2610.33931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. translated_title: HerHealthGPT：一个面向女性生殖健康的、以证据为依据的对话式AI系统
translated_abstract: “为什么我的月经推迟了？”有时，最有用的回答是从另一个问题开始的。然而，对话式AI系统在面对不完整的健康咨询时，往往不会寻求必要的背景信息，也不会将其建议建立在可验证的证据之上。本文提出了HerHealthGPT，一个以证据为依据的对话式AI系统，旨在应对女性生殖健康领域的这些挑战。HerHealthGPT将检索增强生成（RAG）、情境感知的澄清提问和来源验证整合在一个交互式网页界面中。该系统不会立即对不完整的提问作出回应，而是保持对话上下文、提出有针对性的后续问题、检查是否过早下结论，并将其回答建立在检索到的证据之上。我们使用从90个生殖健康案例中提取的540条英文消息对AI组件进行了评估，并开展了针对30名成人的原型问卷调查。证据检索表……
tldr: HerHealthGPT是一个面向女性生殖健康、以证据为依据的对话式AI系统，它融合检索增强生成、情境感知的澄清提问与来源验证，通过主动追问补全不完整的健康咨询，并基于可验证的证据生成回答。
en_tdlr: HerHealthGPT is an evidence-grounded conversational AI system for women's reproductive health that integrates retrieval-augmented generation, context-aware clarification, and source validation to ask targeted follow-up questions and ground its responses in verifiable evidence.
